object_description: compact sculptural four-story volume with a raised roof form
design_condition: The building is placed in the eastern half of the plot and withdrawn from the street, creating a spacious western schoolyard, framing the neighbouring gardens and forming a coherent space with the existing school building.

positive.statement: The clear urban planning skilfully uses the available space and creates well-usable outdoor areas.
The compact structure creates a generous and naturally structured open space.
The entrance square creates a good, clear connection to the existing school building.
The arrangement of the classrooms is well thought out and offers good permeability between units for collaborative work.
The minimalist and abstract design language gives the project a pleasantly essential quality despite its size.
The energy and building technology concept harmonizes well with the overall architectural concept.

negative.statement: The entrance, cloakroom and movement zone need further development, while the stairs must be separated as an escape route and a vestibule added.
The outside space assigned to the classes is missing on the upper floors.
The structural protection of the existing trees may not be successful.
The complex and cost-intensive double-shell exposed-concrete construction should be examined for replacement.
The project comes off worst in terms of system and construction costs.
The project is not convincing enough in its entirety despite an understandable concept and layout.
